qualityGate.goal: photorealistic at close-up product photography distance
qualityGate.workflow: photoscan/photogrammetry -> cleanup -> retopology -> UV -> bake -> PBR/SSS -> GLB

fruit.strawberry.label: Erdbeere
fruit.strawberry.notes: Prototype uses a photo-real cutout so the configurator can demonstrate target surface quality now. Replace with a true multi-angle/3D photogrammetry asset for production rotation. Preserve seed pits, seeds, calyx thickness, red/yellow hue variation and moist specular breakup; never globally oversaturate.

filling.vanilla.label: Vanillecreme
filling.vanilla.sourceStrategy: bespoke sculpt/scan-derived cream surface; displacement from real whipped/butter cream photography
filling.vanilla.notes: ivory, not pure white; spatula ridges, tiny air pockets, compressed edge, slight translucency

dough.vanilla.label: Vanille-Biskuit
dough.vanilla.sourceStrategy: bespoke macro-photogrammetry/material capture from real baked sponge cross-section
dough.vanilla.notes: open crumb with non-repeating pores, golden baked rim, moist interior, torn micro-crumb silhouette

dough.chocolate.label: Schoko-Biskuit
dough.chocolate.sourceStrategy: bespoke macro-photogrammetry/material capture from real chocolate sponge cross-section
dough.chocolate.notes: deep cocoa brown with warm variation, irregular pores/crumbs, avoid flat near-black albedo
